name: Carousel Slide
description: One slide of a carousel, told to keep the same background and light as the others so the set hangs together. Run it once per slide.
prompt: Slide {{n}} of a product carousel: {{product}} shown {{angle}}, consistent {{bg}} background and light with the other slides, small empty band at the bottom for a caption, 4:5, no text
negative_prompt: text, watermark, changed background, duplicated product

slots.name: product
slots.label: Product
slots.help: A product Element; it is injected as its @handle.

author: kilnry
